POST $dir.newAccount as alice
payload {}
$code == 201
capture acct = $header.Location

# The payload is a JWS by the new key, with the account URL and the old key.
POST $dir.keyChange as alice
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": $alice.jwk}
sign inner bob
$body.status == valid

# The new key is bound to the same account, the old key no longer works.
bind bob $acct

POST-as-GET $acct as bob
$body.status == valid

POST-as-GET $acct as alice
error == unauthorized

POST $dir.newAccount as bob
payload {"onlyReturnExisting": true}
$code == 200
$header.Location == $acct

# The old key is free again, and creates a new account.
POST $dir.newAccount as alice
payload {}
$code == 201
$header.Location != $acct

# Rolling over to a key that belongs to another account fails, and the
# response points at that account.
POST $dir.newAccount as carol
payload {}
$code == 201

POST $dir.keyChange as bob
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": $bob.jwk}
sign inner carol
error == badPublicKey
$code == 409
$header.Location == $carol.url

POST-as-GET $acct as bob
$body.status == valid

# A deactivated account's key is still reserved.
POST $carol.url as carol
payload {"status": "deactivated"}
$body.status == deactivated

POST $dir.keyChange as bob
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": $bob.jwk}
sign inner carol
error == badPublicKey
$code == 409
$header.Location == $carol.url

# Rolling over to the current key is malformed.
POST $dir.keyChange as bob
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": $bob.jwk}
sign inner bob
error == malformed

# Missing or malformed inner JWS and oldKey are rejected without a rollover.
POST-as-GET $dir.keyChange as bob
error == malformed

POST $dir.keyChange as bob
payload {}
error == malformed

POST $dir.keyChange as bob
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": {}}
sign inner dave
error == badPublicKey

POST-as-GET $acct as bob
$body.status == valid

# A second rollover, chained.
POST $dir.keyChange as bob
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": $bob.jwk}
sign inner dave
$code == 200

bind dave $acct

POST-as-GET $acct as dave
$body.status == valid

POST-as-GET $acct as bob
error == unauthorized

# The outer JWS must be signed by the account key, with a kid.
POST $dir.keyChange as dave
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": $dave.jwk}
sign inner eve
sign key bob
error == unauthorized

POST $dir.keyChange as dave
payload {"account": "$acct", "oldKey": $dave.jwk}
sign inner eve
sign jwk
error == malformed

bind eve $acct

POST-as-GET $acct as eve
error == unauthorized
